clips.title: The story
paras: In Coldridge Valley, Balir Frosthammer rallies recruits against the Rockjaw troggs. The dwarf guards Dun Morogh as the troggs press into dwarven lands.

Balir Frosthammer calls new recruits to defend Coldridge Valley. Dwarven and gnomish novices have long found safety and training there, but trouble underground has driven violent Rockjaw troggs to the surface. Balir is among the first to raise the alarm. He urges recruits to thin their numbers before they push farther into Dun Morogh.

Balir Frosthammer bears a name shared with Tannok Frosthammer of Kharanos. The two may belong to the same family, whose members stand by Ironforge. They help keep the cold mountain passes safe for travelers, miners, and mountaineers as threats grow across the region.
